classification: Backward-compatible credential trust, billing lifecycle and operations hardening
receiptImpact: No signed receipt, attestation, semantic profile, registry release or partner policy bytes change; verification now consistently enforces the already-published signer role, validity interval and revocation rules.
activationRule: Public credential verification fails closed when the configured key registry is malformed or a signer is not currently admitted. Billing and operations changes affect platform lifecycle accounting and observability only. Existing partner policy ids and activation mappings remain unchanged.

compatibilityMatrix.evidence: The v5 receipt schema, semantic profile, registry release floor and production policy are unchanged; already-required registered execution and safety signers continue to verify.
The production-disabled v2-v4 snapshot-relative verification contract and all historical receipt bytes remain unchanged.
The pinned AEB option 2 contract, pre-trade binding format and active policy are unchanged; invalid or revoked credential signers now fail closed before use.
The frozen external-evidence/v0 rev6 adapter, pinned OracleSafetyCheck v2 carrier and production-disabled policy are unchanged.
OracleSafetyCheck v2 and pre-trade envelope wire formats are unchanged; verification now applies the published key registry role, validity and revocation contract on every public path.
OracleSafetyCheck v3 layout and registry key material are unchanged; existing role and revocation metadata are now enforced consistently instead of being bypassable by configuration.
ThoughtProof pre-trade v2.1, Oracle Watch signed layouts and the locked no-single-provider gate are unchanged; only currently admitted Oracle Watch signers pass verification.
Receipt-adjacent durable record formats, schema bytes and registry references are unchanged; billing durability fixes do not alter partner protocol objects.
The read-only methodology exchange, query window, dataset digest and production-disabled policy are unchanged.
